condition: Proposals must be submitted as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC under REQ-0001.
event: The final proposal exceeds 20 pages or is uploaded after the portal deadline closes.
effect: The proposal is rejected without evaluation.
assumptions: The buyer will accept alternative mechanisms for service level tracking and bidder instructions.
trigger: The draft exceeds 18 pages or upload has not started by 2026-11-30.
responses: Enforce an 18-page limit on the draft.
Upload the PDF one working day prior to the deadline.
residual_exposure: A portal outage on the final day remains.

condition: The service must be live for students by 2027-01-11 under REQ-0013, while work package 1.2 requires up to 15 days.
event: Integration and deployment overrun the 2027-01-11 spring enrollment deadline.
effect: Students cannot sign forms electronically on the first day of spring enrollment.
assumptions: The timeline requirement for the service to be live by 2027-01-11 is excluded from the initial scope.
trigger: Work package 1.2 slips past its scheduled start.
responses: Proritize core API integration tasks first.
Add engineering resources to work package 1.2.
